build_SentenceStats: build a SentenceStats pipeline component to compute sentence-level statistics on documents
create_get_short_sentence_ratio: create a function that calculates the ratio of sentences shorter than a given character threshold
create_get_long_sentence_ratio: create a function that calculates the ratio of sentences longer than a given character threshold
run_SentenceStats_extract_stats: run SentenceStats extract_stats to compute n_sentences, avg_sentence_length, and sentence ratio metrics
test_SentenceStats: test SentenceStats with custom short and long sentence character thresholds and language tokenizer
